sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions prohibit pre-payment charges for floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes if sanctioned before December 31, 2025, and for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, but this loan was sanctioned on December 31, 2025, so it is not covered by either rule.
The loan agreement also states a 3% pre-payment charge on pre-payment or foreclosure.
Because the evidence does not include a rule for loans sanctioned on December 31, 2025, I cannot confirm from the provided material whether a pre-payment charge may be levied for this case.

missing.searched: Checked in-force UCB pre-payment charge directions for loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 and on or after January 1, 2026, plus the loan agreement clause on pre-payment charge.
